name: crawler
brief: Hull crawler: a low six-legged robot that walks on any surface (floors, walls, ceilings, a ship's outer hull) on magnetic feet, flanking players in EVA. A wide, flat, faceted oval carapace in slate blue with ochre bands, a small wedge head at the front with a cluster of four orange-red eyes and a short twin spray nozzle under it, six jointed legs splayed wide, each ending in a round magnetic foot pad glowing cyan underneath. Origin on the surface it stands on, centred in its feet's plane. Weak spot: a hot-magenta core in a cowled cup on the back, behind a grille, seen from above and above-behind, hidden from below and the front. Affix parts: bolted armour plates, a shield emitter, overclock radiator fins, a volatile canister on the tail.
